package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"iter"
	"slices"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Ticks(ctx context.Context) iter.Seq[string] {
	return slices.Values([]string{"t1"})
}
